description:
Start with the free Future of AI course—2 hours, no technical background needed, completely free. You can begin understanding AI and how it relates to you today: https://bluedot.org/minutephysics

This video continues our tour of counter-intuitive space navigation weirdness, this time looking at the surprising capabilities of the bi-elliptic transfer - and how the further you travel, the more fuel you save!

- Two Paradoxes of Space Navigation: https://youtu.be/dLtRtdg67PU
- Hitting the Sun is HARD: https://youtu.be/LHvR1fRTW8g

Link to Patreon Supporters: http://www.minutephysics.com/supporters/
And Facebook: http://facebook.com/minutephysics

Minute Physics provides an energetic and entertaining view of old and new problems in physics -- all in a minute!

Produced by Joshua Chawner
